response.method: amount x (KES per 1 from) / (KES per 1 to), using CBK mean rates; cross rates go through KES

source.dataset: CBK indicative exchange rates against the Kenya shilling, published each business day
source.note: buy and sell are published up to 2024-01-04; from 2024-01-05 CBK publishes the mean only (buy/sell are null).
source.disclaimer: Not affiliated with or endorsed by CBK. Indicative reference rates, not dealing rates. CBK gives no warranty of accuracy.
